description:
## Why

`pkix-lint::EvaluationReport` carries enough metadata to map cleanly onto NIST OSCAL Assessment Results (catalog → profile → assessment-plan → assessment-results). Federal customers already have OSCAL tooling and prefer that schema; commercial GRC tooling increasingly does too.

The mapping is sketched in pkix-lint/src/report.rs:13-26:

```
profile_id → assessment-results.import-ap.href
evaluated_at_unix → assessment-results.metadata.last-modified
rule_bundle_version → assessment-results.metadata.prop[name=rule-bundle-version]
findings → assessment-results.results.findings (non-deviated)
deviated_findings → assessment-results.results.risks[status=deviation-approved]
```

But the adapter itself doesn't exist.

## What

New workspace member crate `pkix-lint-oscal`:

```rust
pub fn report_to_oscal(report: &pkix_lint::EvaluationReport) -> oscal::AssessmentResults;
pub fn report_to_oscal_json(report: &pkix_lint::EvaluationReport) -> Result<String, _>;
```

Uses an OSCAL Rust binding (TBD which crate; or hand-rolled minimal subset).

## Acceptance

- [ ] New crate `pkix-lint-oscal` with `pkix-lint` as a dep.
- [ ] One canonical EvaluationReport → AssessmentResults conversion, with stable field mapping.
- [ ] JSON output validates against OSCAL Assessment Results JSON Schema.
- [ ] Round-trip test: synthetic EvaluationReport → OSCAL JSON → re-parse → check key fields preserved.
- [ ] Independent oracle: NIST oscal-cli validate (if practical) OR pyca/oscal-pydantic round-trip.

## Out of scope

- OSCAL catalog (rule definitions) — that's its own bead if needed.
- OSCAL Assessment Plan generation — output-only adapter.

## Filed as

Tracker for pkix-lint/src/report.rs:26 'A full OSCAL export adapter is planned for the pkix-lint-oscal crate.' Surfaced by PKIX-agp7.2 sweep audit.
